name: Echoes of Earthfall AP
description: Bodiless screams arise as the room rumbles and shakes, as if in the grip of an earthquake.
disable: DC 23 Religion (expert) to exorcise the spirits or DC 23 Intimidation to stand resolute and show the spirits there's nothing to fear; three total successes are required to disable this haunt.
reset: The haunt deactivates once no living creatures are in the cave at the end of a round, then resets 1 hour later as the spiritual energy rebuilds to a breaking point.
routine:
(1 action; illusion, mental) A thunderous explosion rocks the room as the ceiling appears to split open and collapse. This cave-in is an illusion formed from the memories of the dead, but it can inflict real damage. All creatures in the room must attempt a DC 22 Will Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 1d10 Mental Damage damage.

Failure The creature takes (1d10+6) Mental Damage damage and believes the room is filling with rubble—they're Slowed 1 until the start of their next turn as they spend their energy navigating the illusory rockfall.

Critical Failure The creature takes (2d10+12) Mental Damage damage and believes they're pinned by rubble—they're Immobilized until the start of their next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Final Cries of Horror
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature attempts to exit the room

Effect The cavern erupts into terrified cries as a deep rumbling fills the room. All creatures in area C12 must succeed at a DC 22 Will Saving Throw save or become Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure). The haunt then rolls initiative.
